clue.text: I turn green in front of 25's work

definitions.note: a film by Alfred Hitchcock, the answer to 25

indicators.note: places the colour word before the rest of the build in the finished entry

parts.note: vert is the French and heraldic word for green
a go is a turn, as in a game

explanation.surface: Someone feels queasy ahead of some piece of work.
explanation.walkthrough: 25 is SIR ALFRED (Hitchcock), so '25's work' throughout means one of his films; this is his 1958 thriller.
explanation.definitionFit: Hitchcock directed the 1958 thriller of this title, so it is one of his films.

clue.text: Transport is here, not before what 25's lady contrived to do

parts.note: a van transports goods

indicators.note: the word for before is taken away from here

parts.note: ere is an old word for before

explanation.surface: A vehicle is here, not earlier than when a woman engineered something.
explanation.walkthrough: The Lady Vanishes is a 1938 Hitchcock film, hence the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: In The Lady Vanishes the old lady disappears, which is what she managed to do.

clue.text: Rough as a partially covered floor?

definitions.meaning: rough country is craggy and uneven
a floor with a few rugs on it has been ... in a joke sense

explanation.definitionFit: Craggy rough ground is called rugged, and a floor with rugs could jokingly be called that too.

clue.text: Unable to bear work with rotten nail

indicators.note: the letters are worked into a new arrangement

explanation.surface: Unable to stand a job involving a decayed fingernail.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who cannot bear something does not tolerate it.

clue.text: Goldfish love opera

parts.note: the orfe is a golden fish kept in ponds
love is nil, O, in tennis

explanation.surface: A goldfish adores opera.
explanation.definitionFit: Monteverdi's opera about Orpheus is known by its Italian title.

clue.text: Riotous work of 25

definitions.meaning: the ... Riots were protests against tollgates in Wales in the 1840s
a 1940 Hitchcock film based on Daphne du Maurier's novel

explanation.surface: A disorderly piece of work by some artist.
explanation.definitionFit: The name belongs both to the Welsh tollgate riots and to Hitchcock's 1940 film adaptation.

clue.text: They put a bit of ritual into Mass characteristically

indicators.note: only the first letter of the word ritual is used
in a manner of their own, so the letters are arranged in a new order

explanation.surface: They bring a bit of ceremonial into Mass as is their way.
explanation.definitionFit: Romanists, a term for Roman Catholics, are the people the clue describes.

clue.text: Good lad goes round with frightener

indicators.note: the lad surrounds the letter for good

parts.note: a boy is a lad

explanation.surface: A good boy circles about with something scary.
explanation.definitionFit: A bogy is a bogeyman, a figure used to scare children.

clue.text: American fliers act out 25's work

indicators.note: the letters of act are put out of order

parts.note: The Birds is a 1963 Hitchcock film

explanation.surface: American pilots perform an artist's piece.
explanation.definitionFit: Catbirds are songbirds of the Americas, so they are American fliers.

clue.text: A contemptuous remark about boring Arab king

indicators.note: the scornful word goes about the word for boring

parts.note: bah expresses contempt
dull means boring

explanation.surface: A dismissive sound about a tedious Arab ruler.
explanation.definitionFit: Several kings of Jordan, an Arab kingdom, bore this name.

clue.text: Close time?

parts.note: nigh means close or near

explanation.surface: Asking when things shut for the day.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue also defines: after dark is when shops and doors close.
explanation.definitionFit: Darkness is the hour when the day's business shuts down.

clue.text: Inevitable about turn by Russian aircraft getting debugged

indicators.note: the word for inevitable goes about, that is around, the turn and the aircraft

parts.note: what is fated is inevitable
U as in a U-turn
MiG is the Russian fighter-jet maker

explanation.surface: An unavoidable about-turn by a Soviet jet results in the place being cleared of bugs.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about turn' looks like one military phrase, but 'about' is the container signal and 'turn' alone gives U.
explanation.definitionFit: Fumigating a room with smoke or gas rids it of insects, so it has been debugged.

clue.text: Write letters in spring for 25's work

parts.note: to spell is to write out the letters of a word
a bound is a leap or spring

explanation.surface: Writing letters in springtime for some artist's creation.
explanation.definitionFit: Hitchcock's 1945 psychological thriller starring Ingrid Bergman bears this title.

clue.text: Face erratic form by returning legendary horse in 25's work

parts.note: a clock's face is its dial

indicators.note: the word form is shuffled into a new order
the horse's name is read backwards

parts.note: Red Rum won the Grand National, Britain's great steeplechase, three times

explanation.surface: A clock face showing an odd shape beside a famous racehorse coming back in some artist's work.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Face' looks like a verb but is a clock face; 'erratic' makes M FOR, and 'returning' turns the horse round. The Grand National is Britain's most famous steeplechase.
explanation.definitionFit: Hitchcock filmed this thriller in 1954 with Grace Kelly, so it is one of his works.

clue.text: Eatanswill's Mrs Leo after big game?

definitions.text: Eatanswill's Mrs Leo after big game?

parts.words: Eatanswill's Mrs Leo after big game?
parts.note: Mrs Leo Hunter of Eatanswill in Dickens's Pickwick Papers chased celebrities; a leo is a lion, and big game is hunted

explanation.definitionFit: A seeker of celebrities is called this, after Dickens's Mrs Leo Hunter; literally, a big-game hunter after lions.

clue.text: It is a language in support of the Raj

indicators.note: the phrase and language sit in the garment that supports

parts.note: a bra is a supporting undergarment
taken as written, two words run together
Hindi is a major language of India

explanation.surface: A tongue spoken in backing of British rule in the subcontinent.
explanation.definitionFit: The Raj was the period and territory of British rule over the Indian subcontinent.

clue.text: Plants model on joint poles

parts.note: the Model T was Ford's famous car
a reefer is a joint of cannabis
N and S are the north and south poles

explanation.surface: Plants a model on a cannabis cigarette between the poles.
explanation.definitionFit: Tree ferns are large fern plants with trunks.

clue.text: Rates for female quadrupeds?

definitions.meaning: female donkeys, jokingly, formed like lioness or tigress

explanation.definitionFit: To assess something is to value it, and a punning feminine form of ass gives the same word.

clue.text: One's own business in a jam?

explanation.definitionFit: A preserve is both a jam and an area of activity reserved for someone.

clue.text: 25's work chimed with treason wrought amid stress

indicators.note: the shuffled letters go in the middle of the word for stress

parts.note: strain is stress or tension
a bell that chimed rang

indicators.note: worked, so the letters are reworked into a new order

explanation.surface: A film where bells rang alongside betrayal worked up under pressure.
explanation.walkthrough: 'wrought' makes TRANGERSONA from the chiming word and TREASON together, and 'amid' places it after the S of the stress word, before TRAIN.
explanation.definitionFit: Hitchcock's 1951 thriller about two men who meet on a railway journey has this title.

clue.text: See 20
Wessex island?

definitions.meaning: the Earl of Wessex, the late Queen's youngest son
a Canadian province consisting of an island

explanation.definitionFit: The Earl of Wessex's own name and a Canadian island province share this title.

clue.text: Stop rowing on the street

definitions.meaning: '...!' or '... all' is the call to a crew to stop pulling
to be on ... Street is to live in comfort

explanation.definitionFit: The rowing command to rest the oars and the comfortable Easy Street both use this word.

clue.text: See 12
Nearly 12 again, which would be a fluke

parts.note: re means again, as a prefix

indicators.note: the last letter of the 12 answer is dropped

parts.note: the 12 answer is the clock face word

explanation.surface: Almost dialling again, which would be a stroke of luck.
explanation.definitionFit: A redia is a larval stage of a parasitic fluke.

clue.text: Cut part of 25's work?

definitions.meaning: a short extract from a film

explanation.definitionFit: Clipping is trimming, and a short excerpt from a film is also called this.

clue.text: Hitch in exposure of RAF doctor's lie

indicators.note: exposing a lie lays its parts out differently, so the letters are rearranged

parts.note: DR is a doctor; with the possessive it gives DRS

explanation.surface: A snag in revealing an airman's medical officer's falsehood.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Hitch' looks like a snag but is the director's nickname: Alfred Hitchcock was knighted in 1980.
explanation.definitionFit: Hitch was the nickname of Alfred Hitchcock, who became a knight late in life.

clue.text: See 18
Plains heard after 12 more in 25's work

indicators.note: the word is said aloud to give the plains

parts.note: this clue is 27; twelve more makes 39, and The 39 Steps is a Hitchcock film, so the word is steps

explanation.surface: Flat lands mentioned after a dozen more in some artist's work.
explanation.definitionFit: Steppes are the vast grassy plains of Eurasia.

clue.text: Precis a game

parts.note: bridge is a card game

explanation.surface: Summarise a match.
explanation.definitionFit: To shorten a text is to condense it into a precis.
